reviews.t: The amount of brushes are amazing
reviews.x: I didn’t expect to get so many! They don’t have a strong chemical smell like other brushes purchased on amazon. They have such a great variety and they are perfect if you are starting your makeup artist kit. They aren’t really dense but they look like the get the job done. I will be using them today and see how they turn out.

I was worried these would be low quality because they were so cheep, but they are amazing! Soft, durable, don't shed, give even coverage, and the quality and quantity for this price really can't be beat! No regrets on this purchase!

reviews.t: You get what you pay for!
reviews.x: I am so disappointed....... I just received these brushes this morning and they are not what I was expecting. I wasn't expecting *great* brushes for this price-point, but I thought that at *least* the hairs would be cut evenly.  The hairs of almost every brush are uneven, and I will have to trim all the stray ones on all the brushes before use, if I even use them at all. They are very "loose" brushes...soft yes, but that could be because they are "sparse"...again....that is what you get for this

These brushes are worth the money. They feel high dollar which surprised me! They are def brushes id recommend to any makeup lover. They are beautiful and really update my collection.  They didn't have a chemical smell, they did have a new smell :) of course lol. I used my new makeup brushes this morning to do my makeup. They are so amazingly soft <3 I LOVEEE my brushes.

reviews.t: They are ok and the brushes themselves are not bad. I bought two other sets and very happy ...
reviews.x: There are two different orders in this one review.  Both by same company.  The short brushes—The quality of the handles was a little less than I had hoped. But there are many different brushes in this set and really like the eyeshadow brushes.  The black handled set are quite good and overall happy with them.

Wonderful! It came in almost 6 days sooner than said. The only issue is one of the small black brushes has a white paint glob or something like pain on it. It's just where the white is so it didn't bother me. It is a simple thing to miss. Came out with water. Other then that it's a great deal. 22 brushes for $18 total!!! Thank you so much. I'm very happy.

reviews.t: not as rounded as I would like on some of the smaller ones
reviews.x: Brushes are soft, not as rounded as I would like on some of the smaller ones. But this is still a great buy!
Wonderful, affordable brushes for beginners.
Just as described and they are super soft

reviews.t: The handles could be better quality then they are but it's not super bad over all
reviews.x: the positive thing was that it came with alot of brushes the negative things were that the handles themselves weren't the best quality and some of the brushes aren't needed like you dont need 5 face brushes you could literally use a beauty blender for foundation baking concealer I felt like some of the brushes that they had multiples of could have been eyeshadow brushes.in every kit you need lots of eyeshadow brushes so you won't have to constantly rinse the same one out .The handles could have

I love the brushes, but the kabuki brushes and foundation brushes are not dense at all. If you have a full coverage foundation, these brushes will make them medium coverage. They eat up liquid products better than it does blending them. I only give 4 stars because they came as advertised and the eye brushes and contour brushes are perfect. But for liquid foundation and concealers (even tho beauty blenders are prefered for concealing) are the absolute worst. Rather spend $3 for a elf buffing brus

reviews.t: You're paying for the quality of the product!
reviews.x: I actually really loved the brushes, but after the first wash the glue holding the metal to the base came off :( and I didn't even get that area wet. So it was cheap enough to not be really upset, and you're getting a ton of brushes! But I was torn between how well I liked them, and then bummed that they came undone super fast. Also, they hold onto a lot of powder because they're really dense, so just beware of that.

Hey I bought this set of brushes a couple of weeks ago, I took a lil longer to write this review because I wanted to try the all out. So now this are amazing specially for the price ! They are very soft on my skin. One thing I notice that the tips of some of the brushes are uneven. The small one I use them for on the go, they stay in my bag. I definitely recommend this product

reviews.t: So many brushes....and they dont shed.
reviews.x: There are so many brushes i feel like its for a professional. So far i have used 3 brushes and make up glides on well and they dont shed. So far so good and as a non professional I have a feeling i have a lifetime of brushes and can share with family and or friends. Great value for the amount you get.

Lovely brushes and for the price the bristles are actually soft!! However the only down side to these brushes are the smell!! Before I could take them out the package I could smell the chemical coming from it... hopefully when I wash them before use they'll be good..

These brushes are awesome. They're soft and i got all twenty two of them. They came with a paint smell but as soon as you wash them they're okay. Definitely a good purchase. Haven't used them to apply my makeup yet but I'm sure i won't have any problems.

They're alright. Not the best, they're super soft but almost too soft that they're not dense enough to actually blend. They're not bad though, they serve their purpose. I definitely recommend washing these before using, I always do just in case.

They were exactly how I expected them to be. I love the look of the makeup brushes good material and very affordable. I used them when I first got them and I already love them. It makes the perfect gift for a sister or friend.

reviews.t: Not bad for a beginner and not bad for the price
reviews.x: Not too impress with the brushes.  The synthetic bristles are not conducive to pick up the product leading to using a lot of product.  Not bad for a beginner and not bad for the price
Very STRONG chemical or so called fragrance odor, not sure if I want to use these brushes. The odor is very present outside of the packaging, never thought it would the makeup brushes
Very good price for so many brushes.  Happy so far. Seem to be as good quality as some I have paid much more for.  Shared with daughter and she is pleased too.
I like the fact that it’s soft. However few of the brushes, some of it is sticking out which is not good when it comes to trying to perfect the makeups.

reviews.t: You got some money for your money!
reviews.x: You get so many for your money! I like these a lot and they are very cheap.  Highly  recommend.  I like these more than some of my Morphe brushes

reviews.t: I loved how they dont smell
reviews.x: I loved how they dont smell!!. They are very nice and soft. Wish they didny shead as much tho. But u get what u pay for got 22 brushes
I love how soft they are. They blend so well and work!!! I can’t wait to use them more!! Definitely recommend! Will be buying more!!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the large number of brushes included and the overall value for the price.
Many reviewers describe the brushes as soft and good quality, though some note uneven bristle tips or lack of density.
Several reviewers mention the brushes do not shed and perform well in use.
Some reviewers report quality issues such as poor handle quality, glue coming off after washing, or uneven bristles.
A few reviewers comment on a chemical or new smell, with some noting it was absent and others finding it noticeable.
